entries.title: A guide to the sidebar
entries.summary: a new article maps the whole sidebar: what lives in each module at the organization and event level, how to pin the pages you use daily, and where fields, tags and personas moved to. Sessionboard switches every organization to the grouped sidebar on September 25, 2026; organizations with an event starting within 30 days are switched after that event.

entries.title: Recent runs on the Coordinator dashboard
entries.summary: the Coordinator's Dashboard now lists its last ten runs: what each one drafted, how it ended, and how many eligible speakers it did not reach. A finished run used to leave no trace in the product at all.

entries.title: Submission forms read right to left
entries.summary: pick Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, or another right-to-left language on a multi-language form and the form is laid out right to left, not only translated.

entries.title: Find translated fields in Add Field
entries.summary: search the form builder's **Add Field** list by a field's translated name or by locale code, and the row containing your match opens expanded. The **Locked** badge on a standard field now explains on hover that adding a translated variant of it unlocks the row.

entries.title: Portal times name the event timezone
entries.summary: a custom **Date & Time** field in a portal used to render in UTC with nothing on screen naming the zone, so a participant could read a time hours away from the one you entered. It now shows the event timezone with its abbreviation, the way session start and end times already did, and daylight saving is applied per value.

entries.title: File request submissions can notify the event team
entries.summary: when a contact or group submits a file for a file request, you can get a bell notification and an email instead of watching the File Requests tab. **Notifications & Messaging** must be on for the organization, and **File Request Submitted** starts off — turn in-app and/or email on under **Notifications > Preferences**.

entries.title: Session file uploads notify once, and only for participants
entries.summary: uploading files on a session's **Files** tab used to send admins two notifications per upload, both worded as if a revision had been submitted, including when an admin did the uploading. It now sends one, only when a participant uploads, and says whether the file was uploaded or replaced.
